:::{#lem-prediction-error-split}
#### Prediction error splits at the conditional mean

Let $\truemeanf{\Predvar} \eqdef \E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar}$ be the [conditional expectation function](#def-cond-expectation-function) of $\Outvar$ given $\Predvar$.
For any [prediction function](#def-prediction) $\predfnf{\Predvar}$,
the [prediction error](#def-prediction-error) splits as:

$$\esterr{\predfnf{\Predvar}}{\Outvar} = \esterr{\truemeanf{\Predvar}}{\Outvar} + \paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \truemeanf{\Predvar}}$$

:::

::: proof

$$
\ba
\esterr{\predfnf{\Predvar}}{\Outvar}
&= \predfnf{\Predvar} - \Outvar
&& \text{(definition of } \esterr{\predfnf{\Predvar}}{\Outvar} \text{)} \\
&= \paren{\truemeanf{\Predvar} - \Outvar} + \paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \truemeanf{\Predvar}}
&& \text{(add and subtract } \truemeanf{\Predvar} \text{)} \\
&= \esterr{\truemeanf{\Predvar}}{\Outvar} + \paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \truemeanf{\Predvar}}
&& \text{(definition of } \esterr{\truemeanf{\Predvar}}{\Outvar} \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-prediction-error-split}
#### The split in the best-predictor exercise

In @exr-best-predictor,
when $\Predvar = 0$ and $\Outvar = 0$,
the constant [prediction](#def-prediction) $\predfn_1\paren{\Predvar} = 3$ has [prediction error](#def-prediction-error) $\esterr{\predfn_1\paren{\Predvar}}{\Outvar} = 3$.
The conditional mean is $\truemeanf{0} = 1$,
so $\esterr{\truemeanf{\Predvar}}{\Outvar} = 1$ and $\predfn_1\paren{0} - \truemeanf{0} = 2$,
and $3 = 1 + 2$.

:::
